title: Dot type
prompt: Take the dither technique from the Aspen and Iva pins and make it print type instead of images. The pointer is a lens: inside it the letters open up and the paper grows accent dots.
learned: Sampling a word drawn off-screen gives the dot grid for free, and p5 has to wait for the web font before drawing it. A smoothstep on the distance makes the lens edge feel soft instead of mechanical.
